channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Thu Sep 3 — Gas at 8-week high into storage day
item.description: Henry Hub near .94 into the EIA print (~28 Bcf expected); feedgas rebounds past 18 Bcf/d; Hormuz keeps Brent near 7; OPEC+ Sunday.

item.title: Wed Sep 2 — US-Iran war day two, Brent near 96
item.description: US strikes IRGC targets, Iran hits back at Jordan and Bahrain; Brent ~$96, 10-yr at post-2023 high; TTF +130% y/y; gas chops at $2.95; HH storage print Thursday.

item.title: Tue Sep 1 — Hormuz tankers hit, Brent tops $92
item.description: US-Iran escalation and a hawkish Fed open September; gas steady near five-week highs as Freeport returns.

item.title: Mon Aug 31 — Storage surplus shrinks, gas holds five-week highs
item.description: Deep gas: .88 Henry Hub, third straight lean build cuts surplus to 5.5%, Freeport return watch, warm September start.

item.title: Fri Aug 28 — Nvidia blowout; gas at one-month high
item.description: Nvidia's blowout quarter lifts Wall Street; bullish 15 Bcf storage surprise puts Henry Hub at a one-month high; Warsh speaks at Jackson Hole; tariff stand-off and Alberta market redesign.

item.title: Thu Aug 27 — Gas presses $2.90 into storage day
item.description: Henry Hub rallies on early-September heat; ~28 Bcf build expected; LNG maintenance season; TTF surges past €66 on Hormuz fears.

item.title: Wed Aug 26 — Gas firms as ARC-Shell clears final hurdle
item.description: September gas settles at $2.81 into expiry; ARC-Shell gets Investment Canada approval, closing ~Sep 2; oil sheds war premium; storage report Thursday.

item.title: Tue Aug 25 — Heat props up Henry Hub near $2.80
item.description: Henry Hub firm on late-summer heat and returning LNG feedgas; storage build undershoots; TTF at 2023 highs on Hormuz; Continental buys FireBird II; Calgary hits 29C midweek.

item.title: Fri Aug 21 — Gas slips on record supply; TTF surges
item.description: September gas falls ~2% despite light 16 Bcf build; record 111+ Bcf/d production; TTF at highest since March; Hormuz standoff holds Brent near $90; warm sunny Alberta weekend.

item.title: Thu Aug 20 — Gas jumps 3.5% on heat; storage day
item.description: September NYMEX settles .87, highest since July 24; wide EIA storage estimate spread; Keystone XL chatter in US-Canada trade talks; Brent above 3.

item.title: Wed Aug 19 — Texas heat sparks gas rebound
item.description: September gas rebounds 3.6% to .79 on Texas heat and record ERCOT demand risk; storage report Thursday; Hormuz talks stall.

item.title: Tue Aug 18 — Gas slides on record supply
item.description: Henry Hub near 11-week lows on record output and storage surplus; late-August heat ridge builds; Hormuz crisis keeps TTF and oil elevated.

item.title: Mon Aug 17 — Gas slips on record supply; TTF at three-week high
item.description: Sept Nymex gives back Friday's rally amid record production and a 198 Bcf storage surplus; heat holds in the South; Iran talks stall and TTF tops 62 euros; Senate passes Russia sanctions bill.

item.title: Fri Aug 14 — Bearish storage miss knocks gas lower
item.description: EIA +36 Bcf vs +31 expected; Henry Hub ~$2.73; heat holds through late August; Expand Energy buys Twin Eagle for $1.25B; TTF near €60 on Hormuz impasse.
